biological_interpretation: The ER-stress readout is tied to SEC63-mediated ER import/folding stress rather than a generic response to partial TRAP, OST, COPII, ERGIC or glycan-trimming ERAD perturbation.
caveats: Sec63 transcript depletion itself was not measured as an FDR self-row in the report, constraining causal certainty.
Sec61/Sec62 and several polycystic kidney disease ER genes were not in the perturbation library.
exact_observed_result: Sec63 perturbation in 151 TH induced Hspa5, Canx, Hyou1 and Chac1 at FDR, with Pdia4 and Hsp90b1 just below conventional FDR; 155 MB Glut had an Hspa5-only FDR echo. Ssr4, Stt3b, Sec23a, Sar1b, Ergic1 and Edem3 failed to reproduce Hspa5/Canx/Hyou1 induction in matched contexts.

prior_expectation.expectation: SEC63 is an ER translocation factor and HSPA5/BiP is an ER folding/UPR chaperone; the neuronal selectivity over other secretory perturbations is the refinement.
